bible_quanes.question: With what has God blessed us in Christ?
bible_quanes.answer: All spiritual blessings in heavenly places in Christ

bible_quanes.question: When did God choose us in Christ?
bible_quanes.answer: Before the foundation of the world

bible_quanes.question: What do we have in Christ through His blood?
bible_quanes.answer: Redemption, the forgiveness of sins

bible_quanes.question: With what were believers sealed?
bible_quanes.answer: That holy Spirit of promise

bible_quanes.question: To what did God predestine us?
bible_quanes.answer: The adoption of children by Jesus Christ

bible_quanes.question: What is the holy Spirit of promise to us?
bible_quanes.answer: The earnest of our inheritance

bible_quanes.question: What does Paul pray will be enlightened?
bible_quanes.answer: The eyes of your understanding
bible_quanes.explanation: To know the hope of His calling.

bible_quanes.question: What has God put under Christ's feet?
bible_quanes.answer: All things
bible_quanes.explanation: He is head over all things to the church.

bible_quanes.question: What will God gather together in Christ?
bible_quanes.answer: All things in heaven and on earth

bible_quanes.question: What is the church?
bible_quanes.answer: His body, the fulness of Him that filleth all in all

bible_quanes.question: How are we saved, according to Ephesians 2:8?
bible_quanes.answer: By grace through faith, not of ourselves; it is the gift of God

bible_quanes.question: Why is salvation not of works?
bible_quanes.answer: Lest any man should boast

bible_quanes.question: What are we, according to Ephesians 2:10?
bible_quanes.answer: His workmanship, created in Christ Jesus unto good works

bible_quanes.question: What is Christ, according to Ephesians 2:14?
bible_quanes.answer: Our peace

bible_quanes.question: What were we before God made us alive?
bible_quanes.answer: Dead in trespasses and sins

bible_quanes.question: What is God rich in?
bible_quanes.answer: Mercy

bible_quanes.question: What were Gentiles once without?
bible_quanes.answer: Christ, hope and God in the world

bible_quanes.question: What are Gentile believers now?
bible_quanes.answer: Fellowcitizens with the saints and of the household of God

bible_quanes.question: On what is the household of God built?
bible_quanes.answer: The foundation of the apostles and prophets, Jesus Christ himself the chief corner stone

bible_quanes.question: Whom does Paul call the prince of the power of the air?
bible_quanes.answer: The spirit that now worketh in the children of disobedience

bible_quanes.question: What is God able to do?
bible_quanes.answer: Exceeding abundantly above all that we ask or think

bible_quanes.question: What does Paul call himself?
bible_quanes.answer: Less than the least of all the saints

bible_quanes.question: How does Paul pray Christ will dwell in our hearts?
bible_quanes.answer: By faith

bible_quanes.question: What love passes knowledge?
bible_quanes.answer: The love of Christ
bible_quanes.explanation: That you may be filled with God's fullness.

bible_quanes.question: What is the mystery revealed to Paul?
bible_quanes.answer: That the Gentiles should be fellowheirs and of the same body

bible_quanes.question: To whom is God's wisdom made known by the church?
bible_quanes.answer: Principalities and powers in heavenly places

bible_quanes.question: Before whom does Paul bow his knees?
bible_quanes.answer: The Father of our Lord Jesus Christ

bible_quanes.question: What dimensions of Christ's love does Paul pray we comprehend?
bible_quanes.answer: Breadth, length, depth and height

bible_quanes.question: How does Paul describe himself in Ephesians 3:1?
bible_quanes.answer: The prisoner of Christ Jesus for you Gentiles

bible_quanes.question: What do we have in Christ?
bible_quanes.answer: Boldness and access with confidence by the faith of him

bible_quanes.question: What does Ephesians 4:5 list as "one"?
bible_quanes.answer: One Lord, one faith, one baptism

bible_quanes.question: What does Paul say about anger?
bible_quanes.answer: Be angry, and do not sin; do not let the sun go down on your wrath

bible_quanes.question: How should we be to one another?
bible_quanes.answer: Kind, tenderhearted, forgiving
bible_quanes.explanation: As God in Christ forgave us.

bible_quanes.question: Whom should we not grieve?
bible_quanes.answer: The holy Spirit of God

bible_quanes.question: What should we endeavour to keep?
bible_quanes.answer: The unity of the Spirit in the bond of peace

bible_quanes.question: What gifts did Christ give to the church?
bible_quanes.answer: Apostles, prophets, evangelists, pastors and teachers

bible_quanes.question: How should we speak the truth?
bible_quanes.answer: In love
bible_quanes.explanation: That we may grow up in Christ.

bible_quanes.question: What should the one who stole do?
bible_quanes.answer: Steal no more, but labour, that he may have to give to him that needeth

bible_quanes.question: What should we no longer be tossed about by?
bible_quanes.answer: Every wind of doctrine

bible_quanes.question: What should we put off?
bible_quanes.answer: The old man, which is corrupt according to the deceitful lusts
bible_quanes.explanation: And put on the new man.

bible_quanes.question: How should we walk?
bible_quanes.answer: In love, as Christ also has loved us

bible_quanes.question: With what should we be filled instead of wine?
bible_quanes.answer: The Spirit

bible_quanes.question: How should husbands love their wives?
bible_quanes.answer: Even as Christ also loved the church, and gave himself for it

bible_quanes.question: What were we once, and what are we now?
bible_quanes.answer: Sometimes darkness, but now light in the Lord

bible_quanes.question: What should we have no fellowship with?
bible_quanes.answer: The unfruitful works of darkness

bible_quanes.question: What should we redeem?
bible_quanes.answer: The time, because the days are evil

bible_quanes.question: How should we speak to one another?
bible_quanes.answer: In psalms, hymns and spiritual songs

bible_quanes.question: To whom should we submit?
bible_quanes.answer: One another in the fear of God

bible_quanes.question: What great mystery does Paul speak of?
bible_quanes.answer: Christ and the church

bible_quanes.question: What call does Ephesians 5:14 quote?
bible_quanes.answer: "Awake, you who sleep, arise from the dead, and Christ will give you light"

bible_quanes.question: What should children do?
bible_quanes.answer: Obey your parents in the Lord

bible_quanes.question: What should we put on?
bible_quanes.answer: The whole armour of God
bible_quanes.explanation: To stand against the devil's wiles.

bible_quanes.question: What is the sword of the Spirit?
bible_quanes.answer: The word of God

bible_quanes.question: Against whom do we wrestle?
bible_quanes.answer: Principalities, powers, the rulers of the darkness of this world, spiritual wickedness in high places

bible_quanes.question: Which commandment is the first with promise?
bible_quanes.answer: Honour your father and mother
bible_quanes.explanation: That it may be well with you.

bible_quanes.question: What should fathers not do?
bible_quanes.answer: Provoke your children to wrath
bible_quanes.explanation: Bring them up in the Lord.

bible_quanes.question: What is the breastplate in the armour of God?
bible_quanes.answer: Righteousness

bible_quanes.question: What does the shield of faith quench?
bible_quanes.answer: All the fiery darts of the wicked one

bible_quanes.question: Whom did Paul send to the Ephesians?
bible_quanes.answer: Tychicus, a beloved brother

bible_quanes.question: What does Paul call himself in chains?
bible_quanes.answer: An ambassador in bonds
